newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel flat as futures rise but diffs fall.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel flat as futures rise but diffs fall.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was flat on Wednesday as late gains on benchmark IPE gas oil cancelled the effects of weaker premiums, traders said.
June IPE gas oil settled 75 cents higher at $162.25 a tonne, while July IPE gas oil settled $1.0 up at $163.75 a tonne.
Jet barge premiums came under further pressure on Wednesday from perceptions of good availability. Traders assessed premiums levels to be around June IPE +$15.50/+$16.50 fob ARA.
"I think there's quite a lot of material about so that's weighing on the market," said one trader. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
